name: Raindrop.io

pricing.notes: Free includes unlimited bookmarks, collections, highlights, and devices, plus 100 MB/month uploads. Pro includes full-text search, Stella AI beta chat and summaries, AI suggestions, web archive, annotations, reminders, and daily backups. Feature details checked October 6, 2026 at https://raindrop.io/pro/buy and https://help.raindrop.io/stella; price amounts retain their September 12 verification.

pros: One of the most generous free plans anywhere: unlimited bookmarks, collections, and unlimited highlights
Polished apps on every platform — web, Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and all major browser extensions
Strong visual organization with covers, nested collections, and multiple view modes
Public collections make sharing a curated list as easy as sending a link
Pro is cheap at $28/year and adds permanent copies of saved pages plus daily backups
Open API and 2,600+ integrations via services like Zapier and IFTTT
cons: Standard search uses keywords and full text; Stella Pro beta also accepts natural-language questions about saved content. Check which retrieval workflow you need.
Reading experience is basic compared to dedicated read-it-later apps, with no true offline mode
Stella AI is a Pro beta; full-text search, web archive, and annotations also require Pro.
bestFor: Collectors and visual organizers who file thousands of bookmarks into structured collections and want polished apps everywhere without paying.
verdict: A visual bookmark library with generous free collections and highlights. Pro adds full-text search and Stella AI beta for meaning-based retrieval, summaries, and library chat.
overview: Raindrop.io is a bookmark manager that has been in continuous development since 2013 and is widely treated as the benchmark for organizing links at scale. Bookmarks live in nested collections with cover art, tags, and several view modes, and the free plan is unusually generous: unlimited bookmarks, collections, unlimited highlights, and devices, plus import and export. Apps cover the web, Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android, with extensions for Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, and other major browsers. The Pro plan — about $28 a year ($3.25/mo direct) — adds full-text search across saved pages and PDFs, Stella AI beta chat and summaries, plus AI suggestions, permanent archived copies of pages, annotations, reminders, a duplicate finder, and daily backups. Collections can be shared publicly or used collaboratively, and a documented API plus thousands of integrations make it easy to wire into other tools. Raindrop imports from Pocket, browser bookmark HTML files, and most competing services.

faqs.a: Yes — Raindrop.io has one of the most generous free plans in the category: unlimited bookmarks, collections, and devices with unlimited highlights, plus import and export. The paid Pro plan costs about $28/year (or $3.25/month direct, $27.99/year on the App Store) and adds full-text search, Stella AI beta chat, summaries, and suggestions, permanent copies of saved pages, annotations, reminders, and daily backups.

Yes. Raindrop.io is actively maintained and remains one of the most popular bookmark managers, especially after Pocket shut down in July 2025. It has been developed continuously since 2013, ships apps for web, Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android plus all major browser extensions, and continues to receive regular feature updates.

faqs.q: What is the best Raindrop.io alternative?
faqs.a: Choose by workflow: Raindrop offers an unlimited free bookmark library and Stella AI on Pro; Linkwarden and Karakeep offer self hosting; Instapaper and Reader emphasize reading. Marqly offers up to 100 free saves with keyword search, while Pro adds automatic tagging, summaries, and semantic search.

faqs.q: How do I switch from Raindrop.io to Marqly?
faqs.a: Export Raindrop bookmarks as HTML and keep a backup. Marqly accepts Raindrop HTML but does not preserve original save dates. Test a small sample first. Pro adds automatic tagging on import and semantic search; free supports up to 100 saves with keyword search.

Yes. Raindrop.io has a native iOS app with share-sheet saving, collections, tags, and highlights, and it syncs with the web app and browser extensions. Pro pricing through the App Store is $2.99/month or $27.99/year. Saved pages are cached, but there is no dedicated offline reading mode like a read-it-later app.

faqs.q: Can I export my data from Raindrop.io?
faqs.a: Yes. Raindrop offers HTML, CSV, and TXT exports. Check the destination’s accepted format before migrating: Marqly accepts Raindrop HTML (Raindrop’s JSON export is not accepted) and does not preserve original save dates. Pro subscribers also get daily backups. Keep the exported file and test a small sample first.
